id: title:MattPua:support array properties in event schemas

review.posthog_relevance: Adds native support for Array property types in HogQL ingestion and schema enforcement, including coercion and rejection tests.
review.reason: The change adds 'Array' to the PropertyType union and PROPERTY_TYPE_OPTIONS, alongside existing Object and primitive types. This expands the supported property types for ingestion and metadata, allowing PostHog users to store and query array-valued properties. Tests are added for both acceptance and rejection of array values, including nested and mixed arrays, demonstrating the new
review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates the implementation and testing of Array support, the actual benefit depends on whether users currently rely on this or if the implementation is complete and compatible with existing query execution. No production incident or adoption is observed.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are available; no truncation or missing context. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned, as tier assignment requires a complete review and score, not just observations.
